import random
import bisect
import statistics
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(n, value):
    if isinstance(n, bool) or not isinstance(n, int):
        raise TypeError("n must be an integer")
    if n < 0:
        raise ValueError("n must be non-negative")

    numbers = [random.random() for _ in range(n)]

    if numbers:
        avg = statistics.mean(numbers)
        above_average = [x for x in numbers if x > avg]
    else:
        above_average = []

    sorted_numbers = sorted(numbers)
    idx = bisect.bisect_left(sorted_numbers, value)
    count_ge_value = len(sorted_numbers) - idx

    plt.figure()
    plt.plot(sorted_numbers, marker="o")
    plt.title("Sorted Random Numbers")
    plt.xlabel("Index")
    plt.ylabel("Value")
    plt.grid(True)
    plt.show()

    return above_average, count_ge_value
